description: This file defines a PHP class 'BestSeller' within the OpenCart admin module, handling CRUD operations, reporting, installation, uninstallation, synchronization, and related functionalities for the 'Best Seller' module in the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: BestSeller
classes.description: Controller class for the 'Best Seller' module in the OpenCart admin panel, managing module settings, reports, installation, uninstallation, and synchronization procedures.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads language, sets up data array with module configuration, breadcrumbs, links, and loads the view for the bestseller module configuration page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of module configuration data via POST request, including permission check, validation, and saving to database.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the bestseller module, requires modify permission, and invokes the model to perform installation steps.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls the bestseller module, requires modify permission, and invokes the model to perform uninstallation steps.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the bestseller module, checking permissions and adding module record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a module instance identified by 'module_id' after permission check.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Outputs the report view for bestseller data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the bestseller report HTML, including pagination and product data.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes product sales data to update bestseller rankings, with pagination and permission validation.
